decisions.reason: Its combination formulation still has unresolved market prospects and the dedicated page indicates the firm can keep the option open at low cost.
The generic capsule is less differentiated and faces strong price competition, but after only one year its results are not yet conclusive enough to abandon the option.
As a combination film tablet it fits the firm's improved-release strategy, and the uncertainty of early market results justifies keeping the option open.
The supplement is only mentioned on the website, but its low-cost pharmacy-exclusive positioning and the firm's expansion into self-care make the option still worth holding.
